posts.author: Tanabata
posts.body:
Dear Community,
I mainly work with RPG Maker MZ and have a question for you regarding publishing games on Itch and playing them on an iPhone. I am using an iPhone SE (3rd generation).
In the attached images, you can see that depending on how a game is deployed with RPG Maker MZ, black borders appear at the top and bottom of the screen (marked red). I tested this in comparison with RPG Maker MV, and with MV these top and bottom borders do not appear (I used the same dimensions 544 x 416 since I work with 32 x 32 tiles).
Since I would like to continue developing my game using RPG Maker MZ, I wanted to ask if anyone knows how to remove the black borders at the top and bottom in MZ, so that the display on the smartphone looks the same as when the game is deployed with MV.

if Visustella has something similar?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Tanabata said:
In the pictures I used 48x48 but the same screen size 544 x 416.
Click to expand...
but 544x416 is not compatible with 48x48, that is exactly why the other poster asked.
screen size divided by tile size has to result in an integer number without partial tiles.
544 / 48 is 11.333, which is not a full number like 11
and all RM-engines have display problems if the screen size requires partial tiles...
